description: Known-item retrieval queries. Each item has exactly one target memory (an English statement in memories.json) and three phrasings of the same question: en, zh (how a Chinese speaker would ask it, not a word-for-word translation) and mixed (Chinese with English technical terms, as bilingual developers type).

queries.en: Should I put several unrelated changes into one commit?
queries.zh: 几个不相关的改动能一起提交吗
queries.mixed: commit 要不要一个 feature 一个

queries.en: What should the branch history look like when it lands on main?
queries.zh: 合到主分支之前要不要把提交压成一个
queries.mixed: merge 之前要不要先 squash

queries.en: My feature branch is behind main, how do I bring it up to date?
queries.zh: 功能分支落后主分支了，怎么同步过来
queries.mixed: branch 落后 main 了，用 rebase 还是 merge

queries.en: What tense should a commit subject be written in?
queries.zh: 提交说明用什么语气写
queries.mixed: commit message 用过去式还是祈使句

queries.en: Is it fine to force push this branch?
queries.zh: 别人也在用的分支可以强推吗
queries.mixed: 共享的 branch 能 force push 吗

queries.en: How big is too big for a pull request?
queries.zh: 一个 PR 改多少行比较合适
queries.mixed: PR 太大了要不要拆开

queries.en: What data do I run a brand-new pipeline on the first time?
queries.zh: 新写的数据流程第一次跑用什么数据
queries.mixed: 新 pipeline 先拿 mock data 跑通吗

queries.en: Can the demo just show some made-up rows?
queries.zh: 给别人演示的时候能用编的数据吗
queries.mixed: demo 里放点 placeholder 数据行不行

queries.en: What is the first step when fixing a reported bug?
queries.zh: 修 bug 之前第一步做什么
queries.mixed: 修 bug 之前要先写个 test 复现吗

queries.en: Should I add snapshot tests for this component?
queries.zh: 这个组件要不要加快照测试
queries.mixed: 组件要不要加 snapshot test

queries.en: Lots of mocked unit tests, or a handful of integration tests?
queries.zh: 测试应该多写单元测试还是集成测试
queries.mixed: unit test 和 integration test 哪个多写点

queries.en: A test passes sometimes and fails other times because of randomness.
queries.zh: 测试时过时不过，跟随机数有关，怎么处理
queries.mixed: test 里的 random seed 要不要固定

queries.en: How should an answer be ordered?
queries.zh: 回答问题的时候先说什么后说什么
queries.mixed: 回答要先给 conclusion 吗

queries.en: How much detail when explaining something I have never studied?
queries.zh: 我刚开始学的东西要讲多细
queries.mixed: 学新 topic 的时候要不要带例子讲

queries.en: Where should I run this command from?
queries.zh: 给我命令的时候要说明在哪个目录下跑吗
queries.mixed: shell 命令要不要写清楚在哪个 directory 跑

queries.en: What format should a comparison of two libraries use?
queries.zh: 对比几个方案的时候用什么格式展示
queries.mixed: 比较两个 library 用表格还是写段落

queries.en: Which tool manages Python dependencies here?
queries.zh: Python 的依赖用什么工具管理
queries.mixed: Python 项目的 dependency 用什么管

queries.en: Should a service's requirements use exact versions?
queries.zh: 服务的依赖版本要锁死吗
queries.mixed: requirements 里的版本要 pin 死吗

queries.en: Do public functions need type annotations?
queries.zh: 对外的函数要不要写类型标注
queries.mixed: public function 要加 type hint 吗

queries.en: How should a structured record be represented in Python?
queries.zh: Python 里有固定字段的数据用什么来存
queries.mixed: 结构化的 record 用 dict 还是 dataclass

queries.en: Which database for a quick script I will throw away?
queries.zh: 临时写个用完就扔的小脚本用什么数据库
queries.mixed: 一次性的 prototype 用哪个 DB

queries.en: Can I apply the migration the ORM generated as is?
queries.zh: 自动生成的迁移文件能直接执行吗
queries.mixed: auto-generated 的 migration 可以直接 apply 吗

queries.en: When a user deletes something, do we remove the row?
queries.zh: 用户删除的数据是真删还是只做标记
queries.mixed: 用户记录要 hard delete 还是 soft delete

queries.en: What do I need to do before migrating the production database?
queries.zh: 线上数据库做迁移之前要准备什么
queries.mixed: prod 跑 migration 之前要先干嘛

queries.en: How do we style React components?
queries.zh: React 组件的样式一般怎么写
queries.mixed: React component 的 style 用什么写

queries.en: Which state management library for the React app?
queries.zh: React 项目的状态管理用什么
queries.mixed: state management 要不要上 Redux

queries.en: Can the toolbar buttons be just icons?
queries.zh: 工具栏的按钮只放图标可以吗
queries.mixed: toolbar 按钮只放 icon 行不行

queries.en: Should this single service run on Kubernetes?
queries.zh: 就一个服务有必要上 k8s 吗
queries.mixed: 单服务的项目要上 Kubernetes 吗

queries.en: Where do I check a release before it reaches production?
queries.zh: 上线之前先在哪个环境验证
queries.mixed: 上 prod 之前要先发到 staging 吗

queries.en: Is Friday afternoon an OK time to ship to prod?
queries.zh: 周五下午能发版吗
queries.mixed: 周五下午可以 deploy 吗

queries.en: How do I prepare in case a deploy goes wrong?
queries.zh: 发布万一出问题怎么回退，要提前准备什么
queries.mixed: deploy 之前要先写好 rollback 步骤吗

queries.en: What format should service logs be in?
queries.zh: 服务的日志用什么格式输出
queries.mixed: log 要打成 JSON 吗

queries.en: How do I flag a review comment that should not block the merge?
queries.zh: 不影响合并的小意见怎么标出来
queries.mixed: 不 blocking 的 review comment 怎么标

queries.en: Nobody has approved my PR yet, can I merge it myself?
queries.zh: 我的 PR 还没人批准，能自己合吗
queries.mixed: 没有 approval 能自己 merge 吗

queries.en: What should a PR that changes the interface include?
queries.zh: 改了界面的 PR 需要附上什么
queries.mixed: 改 UI 的 PR 要放截图吗

queries.en: One check is red but the change is obviously fine, merge anyway?
queries.zh: CI 挂了但改动肯定没问题，能先合进去吗
queries.mixed: CI 红了能先 merge 吗

queries.en: Where do we write down an architecture decision?
queries.zh: 架构上做的决定记在哪里
queries.mixed: architecture decision 要记在哪

queries.en: When does the changelog get updated?
queries.zh: 更新日志什么时候写
queries.mixed: CHANGELOG 什么时候更新

queries.en: Can I book a meeting for 9am?
queries.zh: 早上九点约个会可以吗
queries.mixed: meeting 排在上午可以吗

queries.en: How do we run the daily stand-up?
queries.zh: 每天的站会怎么开
queries.mixed: daily standup 要开会吗

queries.en: Which editor for stepping through code in a debugger?
queries.zh: 单步调试的时候用哪个编辑器
queries.mixed: debug 的时候用哪个 editor

queries.en: This function has if/else nested four levels deep.
queries.zh: if 嵌套太深了应该怎么改
queries.mixed: 嵌套的 if else 要改成 early return 吗

queries.en: Which exceptions should this handler catch?
queries.zh: 捕获异常的时候应该怎么写
queries.mixed: except 要写具体的 exception 类型吗

queries.en: Something unexpected went wrong, log it and keep going?
queries.zh: 遇到没预料到的错误是继续跑还是直接报错退出
queries.mixed: unexpected error 是 log 一下继续跑还是直接 crash

queries.en: The HTTP call to the other service fails now and then.
queries.zh: 调用外部接口偶尔失败怎么处理
queries.mixed: 网络请求偶尔失败要加 retry 吗

queries.en: Passwords and tokens are showing up in the log output.
queries.zh: 日志里打出了密码和 token 怎么办
queries.mixed: log 里出现 token 和 password 怎么处理

queries.en: Where do I start on a new modelling problem?
queries.zh: 新的建模任务先从哪一步开始
queries.mixed: 新的 ML 任务要先做个 baseline 吗

queries.en: Which split do I use for hyperparameter tuning?
queries.zh: 调参的时候能用留出集吗
queries.mixed: 调 hyperparameter 能用 holdout set 吗

queries.en: What has to go next to a metric when I report it?
queries.zh: 汇报指标的时候要附上什么信息
queries.mixed: 报 metric 的时候要带 sample size 吗

queries.en: Can I work on several tasks in parallel?
queries.zh: 可以同时做好几个任务吗
queries.mixed: 几个 task 能同时开着做吗
